findings: Ten visible navigation destinations are placeholders.
The desktop runs one fixed witnessed fixture rather than an exact user-selected local contract.
Mission progress, relaunch state, settings, and typed recovery states are absent or simulated.
AuthorityReview does not display the normalized contract or action digest before authorization.
daemon/src/nemesis_core_daemon.adb synthesizes an ephemeral capability grant and never consumes Nemesis.Kernel.Approvals.
Receipt verification and tamper rejection pass for the witnessed fixture.
Desktop replay always loads the bundled phase-11 fixture rather than the most recent desktop mission.
GNATprove covers eight named kernel bodies only.
Authority-persistence daemon units remain SPARK_Mode Off.
The proof gate has no nonzero obligation count, coverage completeness, stale-artifact rejection, or semantic A-B-A calibration.
No fresh independent reviewer receipt targets a frozen production candidate hash.
Baseline advisory and license gates pass, and GitHub Actions are commit-pinned.
No production SBOM or build provenance artifact is generated and validated.
Load-bearing text is rendered at seven to nine pixels.
No automated keyboard, VoiceOver, contrast, scaling, or native accessibility-tree gate exists.
No validated launch, idle, mission, replay, growth, soak, or package measurement instrument exists.
Core restart and byte-corruption behavior are exercised.
Force quit, kill-during-commit, disk-full, concurrent ownership, upgrade, uninstall, soak, and duplicate-notification cases are not covered.
The predecessor ships as an ad-hoc ZIP requiring Open Anyway.
No clean /Applications-style install, migration, rollback, downgrade refusal, uninstall, or data-retention gate exists.
No telemetry dependency was found and the witnessed worker denies network.
Privacy, data-location, backup, export, deletion, diagnostics, and log-redaction product documentation and gates are absent.
v0.1.0 is ad-hoc signed, not hardened-runtime Developer ID signed, not notarized, and Gatekeeper rejected it.
Current account and identity capability has not yet been re-probed without exposing identities.
Historical predecessor checks are green; the mission branch has no upstream, pull request, or exact-head hosted run.
Only immutable v0.1.0 assets have published anonymous byte-readback evidence.
No bounded previewable secret-scanned support bundle exists.
Desktop diagnostics check binary presence only; database, verifier, sandbox, version, and resource identity health are absent.

blockers.command: python3 -c 'scan daemon/src/*.ad? for Nemesis.Kernel.Approvals or Consume_Approval; exit 42 when absent'
blockers.finding: Wiring one-shot approvals into authorize_action changes the existing authorization accept condition and requires an exact architect-approved patch.

findings: The production contract requires exact expiring one-shot approvals end to end, while the current daemon authorizes without the Approvals package.
The trust-surface prohibition forbids landing that accept-condition change under broad autonomy.

nonclaims: A valid admission roster proves schema consistency, not production readiness.
Historical v0.1.0 PASS evidence does not close successor production lanes.
